يستقطروا (form X)
# يَسْتَقْطِرُوا (yastaqṭirū) /jas.taq.tˤi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
# يُسْتَقْطَرُوا (yustaqṭarū) /jus.taq.tˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
